EIDESVIK OFFSHORE ASA (org.nr 986 942 785) is registered as Allmennaksjeselskap (ASA), founded 2004-06-03, registered 2004-06-08. Business address: Vestvikvegen 1, 5443 BØMLO. Main industry (NACE): 50.203 Forsyning for offshore. Latest filed annual accounts (2025, company statement): operating result NOK -18,283,000; net result NOK 20,206,000; total assets NOK 1,078,122,000; equity NOK 819,139,000 (the group statement for the same year reports revenue NOK 785,126,000). Leadership: general manager (daglig leder) Helga Cotgrove; board chair Kenneth Walland; 5 other board members. Sub-units registered: 1. Website: www.eidesvik.no. The website describes the company as: "Your partner in shipping" LEI: 5967007LIEEXZXFOMO31 (ACTIVE). Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eidesvik_Offshore.
